headline: Nikkei Asia reports that Taiwanese display makers AUO and Innolux are betting on glass as a base material for AI chips.
score_reason: Lowered from 5: only the opening lines of the paywalled article were readable.
importance_line: Glass bases could allow larger and more powerful AI chip packages, but only the article's opening is available and no production dates are known.
summary: Nikkei Asia reports that AUO, a major Taiwanese display-panel maker, showed a glass-core substrate (the base board a chip sits on) at the Semicon Taiwan trade show in early September, and says glass resists warping, which allows bigger, more powerful circuit boards.
notes: Nikkei paywall: only the first lines were readable (standfirst and one paragraph); no other outlet found.
